title: Add complexity guardrails and architecture conformance checks
description:
Problem: complexity drift can re-accumulate after refactors without enforceable guardrails.

Desired outcome: lightweight guardrails that flag oversized files and boundary drift early.

Scope:
- In scope: automated checks or reports for file-size/cohesion hotspots and architecture-conformance notes tied to active simplification plan.
- Out of scope: heavyweight governance process that slows routine delivery.

Acceptance criteria:
- Guardrail output is available in local/CI validation.
- Drift signals are actionable and linked to owner-facing docs.
- False positive rate is low enough for routine use.

Validation:
- Demonstrate guardrail output against current codebase and post-refactor state.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from F-006 to keep simplification gains durable.
